rulings: RJ-06-01: Shared Additional Action Slot — at most one extra full Action per round; restack attempts are illegal (GAMEPLAY_LOOP_CANON §Action-economy limits).

RJ-06-03: Natural 1 always misses; natural 20 always hits and doubles damage dice totals already rolled.
